pages.title: Keep the Good Stuff
pages.text: Separate useful stock from deliberately disposable junk; a filter and storage base expand safe sorting.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use one cheap isolated exemplar. Allow/reject and advanced component checks differ; Void destroys permanently. Magnet attracts from range, whereas Pickup collects on contact.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Filter constrains actual piped insertion/extraction; choose directions, allow/reject mode and available advanced comparisons.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Void permanently removes filter-matched items. Test a single cheap exemplar; changing advanced filters cannot restore destroyed stock.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Void irreversibly removes matched items; test a cheap isolated exemplar and this container filter.
